budgets.terrain_basis: Measured 5 m regional lattice, twelve 2.5 m and four 1.25 m bounded refinements selected by a 0.25 m native-road error ceiling. Fixed geography budget independent of building detail; measured terrain costs more than the old planar estimates.

limits: Rough editable ground controls, fixed shared water datum, bounded estimated Venetian shore transitions and an independently profiled bridge. The two islands, bank planting, supports, gate location and lamp states remain visual estimates; exact levels and hidden structure are not surveyed.
shore_measurement: Formalhardedge frompier tosouthwestboatend, OSMwateroutlineindices0..48, ±1.5m; lowerlido5.5±1.5m andupperwalk4±1m fromactual3D comparedwithHistoricEngland6mMarineWalk/1.2mdrop. NaturalNWbank remainsplanted withmappedpath; no inventedcontinuousbalustrade.

esplanade_access_ramp.basis: Loaded3D ramp besideEsplanade shelter andHistoricEngland broad descendingaccess; slope/width estimated, no survey.

coast_basis: Aug 2026 loaded opposite-facing Marine Drive panorama confirms low concrete sea wall and rails beyond asphalt lower path. This pass keeps a 0.8m wall envelope matching the prior north segment; detailed raised upper walk, stairs and railing remain uncertain. Outboard land is a sand reservation, not a tidal/height survey.

venetian_structure_budgets.note: Open fixed-count District posts, rails and principal supports; no photographic atlas.
